title: AuditDoc
description:
The `--audit-json` document (schema 1). Every field but `meta`, `ran` and
`parallel_safe` is absent when the audit did not run.

inconclusive.description:
Tests that failed in the parallel pass but did not run in the follow-up
runs, so could not be classified. They still fail the gate.

intrinsic_flakes.description: Tests that fail intermittently whatever the scheduling (intrinsic flakes).

meta.description: Envelope: producer, document kind and schema version.

order_dependent.description:
Tests that pass under `--dist loadfile`: they depend on a sibling in
their file running first, so keep the file together rather than serial.

parallel_safe.description:
Whether the suite is parallel-safe (no parallel-only failures). Always
`false` when the audit did not run.

preexisting_failures.description:
Tests that already fail at `-n 0`: pre-existing, not a parallelism
issue, and not counted against the gate.

ran.description: Whether the parallel pass produced a run to audit.

serial_candidates.description: Tests fixable by pinning them to `@pytest.mark.serial`.

serial_conftest.description: A paste-able `conftest.py` block that marks every serial candidate.

tests.description: Tests audited (0 when the selection matched nothing).

AuditMeta.description: Envelope metadata for the audit document.

fix.description: The underlying (non-stopgap) fix for this verdict.
